headlines.description: The Dallas Mavericks topped the New York Knicks, 104-102, Sunday night in Larry Brown's debut at Madison Square Garden.
headlines.shortLinkText: Knicks fall to Mavs in Brown's Garden debut

headlines.description: Rashean Mathis scored on a 41-yard return of a TommyMaddox-thrown interception in overtime and the JacksonvilleJaguars, taking advantage of four Maddox turnovers, rallied toupset the injury-thinned Steelers 23-17 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Without Roethlisberger, Ward, Steelers fall to Jags
